title: Stock Market News Collector — Key-Value Store
description: Run metadata and summaries written by the Actor to the default key-value store.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: JSON summary of the collection run, including per-feed stats, failures, and run status.

count.description: Number of news articles written to the dataset.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run started collecting feeds.

runStatus.description: Overall run outcome. The Actor exits successfully unless failOnAllFeedsFailed is set; inspect this field for details.

statusMessage.description: Human-readable summary of the run outcome.

onlyNewArticles.description: Whether articles returned by earlier runs were skipped.

skippedAlreadySeen.description: Articles skipped because earlier runs already returned them.

stateKey.description: Key of the onlyNewArticles history record in the stock-market-news-state key-value store.

spendingLimitReached.description: True when output was cut to stay within the user's maximum cost per run.

fullTextStats.description: Count of articles per fullTextStatus when includeFullText is true.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues encountered during the run.

feedStats.description: Per-feed raw/kept counts or error details.

failures.description: Feeds that could not be fetched after retries.
